given: a stock row whose inventory_code is a well-formed location-batch-serial code such as "A12-B7-S001"
when: the migration backfills the new columns
then: batch_number holds the second hyphen-delimited segment and serial_number holds the third segment of that code

independence.rationale: AC1 only asserts the columns exist; this adds the distinct outcome that a conforming code is parsed by delimiter into the correct segment values

architectural_notes: Infra layer: the backfill data-transform inside the same Alembic up-migration, splitting inventory_code on the hyphen delimiter (segment 2 -> batch_number, segment 3 -> serial_number). The parse rule is migration-owned deterministic logic, not boundary or service business logic. Owner module: the Alembic migration's data step. Verified by a real-branch integration test that seeds a well-formed code and asserts the two segments land in the correct columns after upgrade.
